label: Rival: an act done at every accessible world strictly yields every actual concrete being
paraphrase: Rival (a necessary sufficient cause necessitates everything; the collapse objection to a simple necessary creator, #462/#555), analyst formulation: some act token of some output profile on the route's own Ontic is performed at every world accessible from w and is strictly efficacious for every concrete individual existing at w (each exists at every accessible world where the token is performed). It does not say the token is God's or that the profile's source is the route's root.
